site.name: shkriuss
site.description: Small, private web apps. Your data stays on your device.

apps.name: Tally
apps.description: Count anything with a tap. Your counts stay on your device.
dataStored: Counter names and counts
If you turn on sync: a copy of your counters on Tally's server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.name: Calendar
apps.description: Plan your days. Your events stay on your device.
dataStored: Your events: titles, dates, times, repeats, reminders and notes
When reminders were last checked, so each one shows only once
If you turn on reminders while Calendar is closed: this device's notification settings and a random device key (never in backups)
If you turn on sync: a copy of your events on Calendar's server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Which holidays and fasts to show
Your light or dark theme choice
